'''Sim''' is the innkeeper the [[King's Lancer]] in [[Sienda]], [[Amadicia]]

== Activities ==
Part of his inn is destroyed by a boar-horse from [[Valan Luca]]'s menagerie, forcing many of the guests to stay at another inn. {{ref/book|5|13}}
